semiconductor_relevance: High — Thales System Corporation provides high precision analyzers and optimization services specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Thales System Corporation specializes in high precision analyzers and optimization services tailored for the semiconductor sector. Established in 2010, the company focuses on enhancing service quality and has plans to expand its laboratory capabilities in Taiwan and Shanghai.
